headline: Idaho Botanical Garden nearly doubles in size
pages: The Idaho Botanical Garden, at the base of the Boise Foothills, nearly doubled in size earlier this year with a 10-acre expansion. The new area includes a young arboretum whose trees will eventually grow tall enough to shade visitors, a new event lawn, and several gardens showcasing plants that heal, amaze or help feed people. The expansion also reaches the parking lot, where a new bike garden can hold 177 to 200 bikes, with raised planter beds, seat walls and a bike pavilion.

Colin Lyman, the garden's director of horticulture and facilities, said cactus and succulents will be planted in the rock wall next spring, using heat reflected from the concrete to create microclimates for plants that normally would not grow there. Boise State Public Radio noted the garden is a financial supporter of the station but had no involvement in the story. Source: Boise State Public Radio.
